notes.title: Quick Fix Update – Menu Issue Resolved!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,



Thanks so much to everyone who checked out Wake Explorer at launch! We really appreciate your support and feedback.



We wanted to let you know we’ve just pushed a small update to fix an issue with the in-game menu that some players encountered. Everything should now be working as intended — smoother and more responsive.



If you experienced any problems navigating the menu before, this update should take care of it. Please restart the game or verify your files if the issue persists.



If you run into anything else, feel free to reach out.



Thanks again for playing!

– The Wake Explorer Team
